resources.string: Automatic second destination
Once a day, if anything changed, %1$s makes a backup in a folder on this phone, a card or a USB drive, with or without a connected cloud. It keeps the last 3.
Keep this folder up to date
Every cloud backup is also kept here, and without a cloud or internet one is made a few minutes after each change. It keeps the last 3 and the last one from each of the two previous days.
That folder is not on the phone, an SD card or a USB drive. Choose another one.
Choose folder
Folder: %1$s
Last backup here: %1$s
Change folder
Remove destination
Remove this destination?
Files already in the folder stay there, but no more backups will be saved to it.
The folder was not found. The card or drive may be out.
Permission for the folder was lost. Choose it again.
The last backup at the second destination could not be checked. The backup in the cloud did not change.
The backup for this folder could not be encrypted. The recovery code is needed.
Today\'s backup was not saved here because it could not be restored. Earlier ones are still in the folder.
Find my backup on this phone
Local backups stay on the phone even if %1$s is uninstalled. Choose their folder and allow access.
Newest backup in this folder: %1$s, %2$s
This folder has no %1$s backups. Choose another folder or find a file.
The folder is connected again as the second destination.
